name: Track list
summary: An album or playlist: a cover photo, title and artist, play, shuffle and save, then numbered tracks with their length, an explicit tag, a like heart and the playing one marked.
use: on an album, playlist or mixtape page
a11y: An ordered list where each whole row is one button that names the track, number and length; the playing row has aria-current, and like, save and shuffle are toggle buttons with aria-pressed.

use_when: a page where the listener picks one track to start, sees which one is playing and likes tracks one by one
avoid_when: controls for the track that is playing now: use music-player
a list of episodes with descriptions and dates: use podcast-episodes
a row of album or show covers to browse: use media-shelf

parts.name: eyebrow
parts.what: the kind of release and its year

parts.name: by
parts.what: the artist with a small photo, then the song count and length

parts.name: save
parts.what: a toggle to save the album to the library

parts.name: tracks
parts.what: one track: number (or a moving bars icon when current), title, explicit tag, artists, like heart and length

parts.name: like
parts.what: a like toggle on one track

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a track will not play, keep the list and show a toast-stack message naming the track

disabled.how: for a track that cannot be played, set disabled on its row button and grey its title

overflow.how: on wide boxes the cover sits beside the title and a column header appears; on narrow ones the cover sits on top

long_text.how: track titles and artist names stay on one line and end in an ellipsis

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Play, Shuffle, Save and More options, then each track's row and its Like button in order
Enter or Space on a track row plays it and marks it as current
Enter or Space on Play switches between play and pause
Enter or Space on Shuffle, Save or a Like toggles it on or off
More options is a button with no action wired in the file
